basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 22-year-old gamer based in Berlin, Germany. I've recently gotten into Rainbow 6 Siege and am looking to make new friends to play with. I'm currently a university student studying computer science, which keeps me busy during the weekdays. I dislike toxic gaming environments and am all about casual and fun gameplay. My online hours are typically late evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new games and tech trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a computer science student, I have a solid understanding of technology and gaming. My interest in tech was sparked by building my first PC at age 16, and I've been learning more through online courses and forums.
